summary: Someone about to quit stops looking after colleagues who gave advice but keeps up with those who are friends.
realLife: A University of Exeter study of people considering leaving found they stopped nurturing ties with colleagues who advised them and kept ties with friends, partly fearing the loss of close bonds.
sources: University of Exeter news archive, Job hunters drop ties with supportive colleagues: https://news-archive.exeter.ac.uk/2018/april/title_653456_en.html
inGame: coworker ties with closeness changing when a job search begins and ending in a job-ended event.

turns.summary: The friendship continues through the move.
The adviser notices the leaver's change and cools.
The leaver later calls to bring a friend to the new firm.
turns.writesBack: job lead for the friend; tie closer
